# Base32

Base32 in the RFC 4648 and Crockford alphabets.

<h2 id="base32-variant"><code>Base32Variant</code></h2>

```rux
pub enum Base32Variant {
    Standard,
    StandardUnpadded,
    Crockford
}
```

Which Base32 alphabet a text uses, and whether it is padded.
Copy, carrying no payload.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Base32.rux#L19)

**Cases**

| Name               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `Standard`         | The RFC 4648 alphabet, `A` through `Z` then `2` through `7`, padded with `=` to a multiple of eight characters.                                                                                                    |
| `StandardUnpadded` | The RFC 4648 alphabet without padding, which is how one-time-password secrets are usually written.                                                                                                                 |
| `Crockford`        | Crockford's alphabet, `0` through `9` then the letters except `I`, `L`, `O` and `U`, without padding. Read leniently, as its specification asks: either case, `I` and `L` as `1`, `O` as `0`, and hyphens skipped. |

<h2 id="base32-encoded-length"><code>Base32EncodedLength</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Base32EncodedLength(
    length: uint,
    form: Base32Variant
) -> uint
```

How many characters the Base32 form of `length` bytes occupies in `form`.
Eight characters for every five bytes, with a final partial group taking two, four, five or seven characters,
or eight with padding. Cannot fail for any length a slice in memory can have; runs in constant time and
allocates nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Base32.rux#L48)

**Parameters**

| Name     | Type            | Description                             |
| -------- | --------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `length` | `uint`          | the number of bytes to encode           |
| `form`   | `Base32Variant` | the alphabet and padding to encode with |

**Returns**: the number of characters [`Base32Encode`](/docs/api/encoding/base32#base32-encode) writes

<h2 id="base32-encode"><code>Base32Encode</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Base32Encode(
    bytes: byte[..],
    into: var char8[..],
    form: Base32Variant
) -> uint ! FormatError

pub func Base32Encode(
    text: char8[..],
    into: var char8[..],
    form: Base32Variant
) -> uint ! FormatError
```

Writes `bytes` as Base32 into `into`.
Letters are written in upper case in both alphabets. The RFC 4648 variants run in time that depends only on the
length of `bytes`. Reports `InsufficientCapacity` when `into` is shorter than
`Base32EncodedLength(bytes.length, form)`, leaving it exactly as it was; room past the encoded form is not
touched.

| Overload                                                                                                 | Summary                                           |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func Base32Encode(bytes: byte[..], into: var char8[..], form: Base32Variant) -> uint ! FormatError` | Writes `bytes` as Base32 into `into`.             |
| `pub func Base32Encode(text: char8[..], into: var char8[..], form: Base32Variant) -> uint ! FormatError` | Writes the bytes of `text` as Base32 into `into`. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Base32.rux#L122)

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type            | Description                                                                    |
| ------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `bytes` | `byte[..]`      | the bytes to encode                                                            |
| `into`  | `var char8[..]` | the destination, at least `Base32EncodedLength(bytes.length, form)` characters |
| `form`  | `Base32Variant` | the alphabet and padding to encode with                                        |
| `text`  | `char8[..]`     | the text whose bytes to encode                                                 |

**Returns**: the number of characters written

<h2 id="base32-decoded-length"><code>Base32DecodedLength</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Base32DecodedLength(
    text: char8[..],
    form: Base32Variant
) -> uint ! DecodeError
```

How many bytes the Base32 text decodes to, after checking its length and the placement of its padding.
Only the shape is checked; the characters are checked by [`Base32Decode`](/docs/api/encoding/base32#base32-decode). The padded variant needs a multiple of
eight characters; every variant needs the data characters to leave a final group of zero, two, four, five or
seven. Hyphens in Crockford text are not counted. Reports `InvalidLength` at the end of the text, or
`InvalidPadding` at the first `=` that is out of place. Runs in time linear in the length and allocates nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Base32.rux#L219)

**Parameters**

| Name   | Type            | Description                                          |
| ------ | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `text` | `char8[..]`     | the Base32 text                                      |
| `form` | `Base32Variant` | the alphabet and padding the text is expected to use |

**Returns**: the number of bytes [`Base32Decode`](/docs/api/encoding/base32#base32-decode) writes for it

<h2 id="base32-decode"><code>Base32Decode</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Base32Decode(
    text: char8[..],
    into: var byte[..],
    form: Base32Variant
) -> uint ! DecodeError
```

Reads Base32 text in `form` into `into`.
The RFC 4648 variants run in time that depends only on the length of `text` when the text is valid. Reports, in
this order of precedence, `InvalidLength` or `InvalidPadding` for a text of the wrong shape, `InvalidCharacter` at
the first character outside the alphabet, `NonCanonical` at a last character whose unused bits are not zero, and
`InsufficientCapacity` with the length needed when `into` is too short. Every refusal leaves `into` untouched,
because the whole text is checked before anything is written.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Base32.rux#L235)

**Parameters**

| Name   | Type            | Description                                                       |
| ------ | --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `text` | `char8[..]`     | the Base32 text to decode                                         |
| `into` | `var byte[..]`  | the destination, at least `Base32DecodedLength(text, form)` bytes |
| `form` | `Base32Variant` | the alphabet and padding the text is expected to use              |

**Returns**: the number of bytes written
